text:
anya: Heads up — saw a surge of PCIe corrected errors on rack7-host21 over the last 20m, coincident with p99 spikes for several multi-tenant slices. thinking soft-cordon + move high-SLA tenants to warm dedicated nodes.

infra-bot: ALERT: pcie_crc_errors exceeded threshold on rack7-host21 at 2026-03-18T22:10Z.

mike: can you paste the prometheus query and which tenants hit it?

anya: `increase(node_pcie_crc_errors_total{host="host21"}[10m])` -> 29. impacted: analytics-batch, ui-test, ad-sim.

sam: agree with soft-cordon. avoid mass eviction; migrate analytics-batch to reserved warm node in us-west-1-edge. I'll run warm-pool-swap.

mike: capture `dmesg` + `nvidia-smi` and open HW ticket if counters persist. also enable egress shaper on migrated slices (we saw NVLink saturation before).

anya: applied soft-cordon: `infractl cordon host21 --soft`. starting graceful drain for preemptibles.

infra-bot: ACTION: soft-cordon applied by anya. new placements blocked.

sam: migration kicked off for analytics-batch. ETA ~8m.

mike: please upload telemetry to S3 and tag PLAT-4302.

anya: uploaded logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/logs/host21/pcie-20260318.log. current error rate decreased to ~3/10m after cordon. monitoring.

sam: if rate stays >2/10m for next hour, schedule rack maintenance in maintenance window.

anya: noted. will update thread in 30m. :thumbsup:
